completion_check.description: A meaningful observable check for this proposed action. Do not claim unseen worksheet completion or unknown prior task state.

dependencies.description: Only step_id values of earlier actions in THIS candidate. Never task_id, goal IDs or evidence IDs. No missing target, duplicate, self-loop, cycle or forward dependency.

estimated_duration.description: Use MODEL_ESTIMATE with explicit uncertainty for your estimate, or UNKNOWN/null. Citations do not prove duration. UNKNOWN is not zero or budget compliance; original checks may block it.

evidence_refs.description: Exact IDs from the supplied reference_catalog. An ID identifies evidence; it does not prove semantic support.

resource_ids.description: Only exact IDs from encoded_planning_fields.resources. Evidence facts are not automatically resources. Empty when no resources are supplied.

schedule.description: Use the original calendar contract. Every action requires a supported schedule when scheduling is required; null never certifies successful scheduling.

step_id.description: Unique local action identifier in THIS candidate, e.g. step_1. Distinct from task IDs, evidence IDs and resource IDs.

task_id.description: Identity of the proposed task, e.g. proposed_task_1, or an exact supplied historical task ID when applicable. Never invent historical acceptance; preserve completion and prerequisite rules.

continues_plan_id.description: Null unless an actually adopted active plan is supplied; a non-null value must be its exact ID.

evidence_refs.description: Exact IDs from the supplied reference_catalog. An ID identifies evidence; it does not prove semantic support.
